services.name: Picnic Rentals
services.desc: The Coach House is a unique historic property available for event rentals. Constructed over 120 years ago, this former carriage house is Oakville's newest community gathering place. The interior space is best suited for meetings and small social events for up to 35 people. Rentals include the seasonal use of the outdoor terrace, weather permitting. The Coach House is surrounded by stunning gardens, lakeside views and the charming Old Oakville Heritage Conservation District. All permits require $2 million dollars liability insurance naming the “TOWN OF OAKVILLE” as an additional insured, or $5 million dollars for any alcohol licensed events.
